Hi Sarah — thanks for the heads up and for sending the VAT reg.

Quick options so we can clear the invoice this week:
1) Secure card update link: I can send you a PCI-compliant card update link (hosted by our payments partner) — the system will trigger SCA/3DS where required.
2) Retry the existing token: we can ask Stripe to reattempt authorization; sometimes a second try prompts a bank challenge (3DS). This works if the card issuer supports SCA.
3) Split the invoice into two smaller charges (two equal charge attempts). Smaller amounts sometimes reduce issuer friction for international cards.
4) Wire/SEPA transfer if you prefer no card attempt (we can reissue bank details and mark invoice as pending).

Before we retry: please confirm whether HelioDynamics wants us to attempt the saved card again (I can authorize one reattempt), or send the update link. If you prefer a wire, let me know and I'll open the wire-invoice route.

I copied Laura (payments ops) and Marcus (billing) to coordinate the retry and VAT handling. If you can reply with which option, we’ll move quickly.
